title: A restaurant demo is built on a restaurant, hotel or plain business template, never on a template made for another trade
steps: S1: choose a template for a restaurant from the 28 cards develop offered on 19/10/2026, once per CMS.
S2: choose between a beauty spa card and a plain business card; between a charity card and a hotel card; with a restaurant card added.
expect: S1: Joomla picks ja-resort (hospitality-match), never ja-spa; WordPress picks ja-morgan (multipurpose-match), never ja-impact; EmDash, offered only other trades, picks its first card and says first-available.
S2: the plain business card (business-match); the hotel card (hospitality-match); the restaurant card (restaurant-match).
evidence: PR 1433; before it, develop's cards gave Joomla ja-spa (the word spa matched the hospitality tier) and WordPress ja-impact (first-available), seen on the WordPress demo wp-marigold1 on stand wo, 18/10/2026
fence: chooseTemplate's tier order and its other-trade exclusion

tests: a restaurant template wins whenever one is offered
Joomla on develop: the hotel and resort template, never the beauty spa
WordPress on develop: the multipurpose business template, never the charity one
a hotel or resort template beats a template made for another trade
a beauty spa is not hospitality for a restaurant
with only other trades on offer, the first one is taken and says so
